steps.summary: Accept cultured adherent mammalian cells at the protein-harvest point.
Remove culture medium, wash the monolayer, lyse on plate in cold inhibitor-containing RIPA buffer, and collect crude lysate.
Clarify the crude lysate at 12,000 x g and retain the soluble protein-containing fraction.
Prepare BCA working reagent and standards, assay duplicate sample and standard wells, and record the loading-volume criterion for 30 ug protein.
Prepare, mix, heat-denature, and briefly spin down a reducing SDS-PAGE sample.
Prepare the Bis-Tris gel and electrophoresis tank, then load the prepared sample and prestained marker lanes.
Run stacking and separation voltage stages and collect the separated gel-lane outputs.
Activate and equilibrate a PVDF membrane, assemble the transfer stack, and transfer proteins at 100 V for 90 min at 4 C.
Rinse, block, and wash the transferred PVDF membrane before antibody incubation.
Incubate the membrane with mouse anti-alpha-tubulin primary antibody and remove the antibody solution.
Wash the primary-antibody-treated membrane three times with TBST.
Incubate the membrane with Alexa Fluor 680 secondary antibody under dark protection and remove the antibody solution.
Wash the fluorescently stained membrane three times with TBST under dark protection.
Acquire a structured 680-nm Western blot image readout and retain the stained membrane as the protocol output.
